headline_marked: 24 Awami League leaders [[placed on 10-day remand]] for Gulshan procession
headline: 24 Awami League leaders placed on 10-day remand for Gulshan procession
summary: The accused are facing charges under the Anti-Terrorism Act after allegedly detonating cocktails during a banned rally in Dhaka's Gulshan area.
details: A Dhaka court has placed 24 leaders and activists of the Awami League and its associate bodies on a 10-day remand each. This follows their alleged involvement in a procession in Dhaka’s Gulshan area last Friday.
The court order was passed by Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Sarah Farzana Haque. One other accused, Mohammad Arafat, was sent to jail after the defense claimed he was a minor.
Police arrested 25 people in Gulshan-1 on Friday while they were allegedly taking part in a procession. A case was subsequently filed against 118 leaders and activists, including the 25 arrestees.
According to the case statement, the group allegedly gathered in front of a KFC restaurant on road No. 3 in Gulshan-1 and marched toward Police Plaza.

The accused are alleged to have carried explosive substances to undermine the elected government and carry out acts of sabotage. Police reports state that several cocktails were detonated, creating panic in the area.
Police responded by firing two rounds of rubber bullets to disperse the crowd. Five unexploded cocktails were reportedly left behind by the participants as they fled the scene.
The activities of the Awami League and its associate bodies are currently banned until the conclusion of ongoing trials at the International Crimes Tribunal regarding the July uprising.

headline_marked: 4 killed as lorry hits microbus [[returning from wedding in Chattogram]]
headline: 4 killed as lorry hits microbus returning from wedding in Chattogram
summary: The victims include the bride's brother and sister, who were heading home to Cox's Bazar after a ceremony in Agrabad.
details: Four people were killed and seven others injured when a lorry hit a microbus carrying relatives returning from a wedding in Karnaphuli upazila, Chattogram.
The accident occurred around 2:00 am on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar highway at Patiya-Anwara crossing.
The deceased have been identified as Niaz Morshed (22), his sister Mimtah (17), their maternal uncle Md Ferdous Alam (55), and the microbus driver, Md Munna.
The family had attended a wedding ceremony at a community centre in Agrabad and were traveling back to Cox's Bazar when the crash happened.
According to Karnaphuli Police Station OC Nur Ahmed, the lorry hit the microbus while making a high-speed U-turn near the crossing.
Ferdous and Mimtah died on the spot, while two others passed away after being taken to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).
Seven other injured passengers were admitted to CMCH, with five remaining in critical condition.
Police have seized the lorry, but the driver and helper have fled the scene.
caption:
A wedding celebration turns into tragedy as 4 people, including a bride's siblings, are killed in a highway crash.

Four people were killed and seven others injured when a lorry hit a microbus carrying relatives returning from a wedding in Karnaphuli upazila, Chattogram.

The accident occurred around 2:00 am on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar highway at Patiya-Anwara crossing.

The deceased have been identified as Niaz Morshed (22), his sister Mimtah (17), their maternal uncle Md Ferdous Alam (55), and the microbus driver, Md Munna.

The family had attended a wedding ceremony at a community centre in Agrabad and were traveling back to Cox's Bazar when the crash happened.

According to Karnaphuli Police Station OC Nur Ahmed, the lorry hit the microbus while making a high-speed U-turn near the crossing.

Ferdous and Mimtah died on the spot, while two others passed away after being taken to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).

Seven other injured passengers were admitted to CMCH, with five remaining in critical condition.

Police have seized the lorry, but the driver and helper have fled the scene.
